description: Echo-TTS is an English zero-shot voice-cloning TTS model packaged for audio.cpp. A 2.8B diffusion transformer generates 80-D latents in PCA space which the Fish S1-DAC decodes to 44.1 kHz audio. Generation is a fixed 29.72 s window (640 latents).

request.name: target_voice
request.description: Reference audio path for zero-shot cloning. Wav only; no transcript required.

request.name: cfg_scale_text
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale on the text condition.

request.name: cfg_scale_speaker
request.description: Classifier-free guidance scale on the speaker condition.

request.name: speaker_kv_scale
request.description: Force-speaker KV scaling. 1.0 disables; 1.5 is the upstream default when enabled.

request.name: seed
request.description: RNG seed for the initial latent.

download.reason: Echo-TTS model packaging is not implemented yet.
